neighbours.label: ' to' closing a 'from X to Y' range or span (time, place, color, extent), vs infinitive and directional ' to'
fire: The museum is open from Monday to Friday each week.
Temperatures vary from cold to mild in this region.
The highway runs from Denver to Kansas City.
Scores ranged from 40 to 95 on the final exam.
He worked there from 1990 to 2005 as a clerk.
The kids changed from pajamas to school clothes in a hurry.
Shades go from pale pink to dark red as the fruit ripens.
We cleaned the house from top to bottom on Sunday.
quiet: The museum sent a letter to every member last week.
Temperatures are expected to rise in this region.
The highway leads to a small farm near Denver.
Students hoped to pass the final exam.
He moved to Chicago in 1990 to work as a clerk.
The kids ran to school in a hurry.
The fruit begins to ripen in late summer.
We promised to clean the house on Sunday.

predictions: Range ' to' after 'from X' reaches 0.6-0.85; infinitive and directional ' to' stay under 0.05.
notes: Probe: 'from silver to deep green' 0.826, 'start to finish' 0.797, 'May to September' 0.780, 'London to Paris' 0.618; 'walked to the store to buy' 0.021, 'learn how to swim' 0.004, 'between ten and twenty' 0.039. A layer-0 unit, so the 'from' context is read through attention.
